description: 车对g兵 — 让兵升变后立刻吃掉

intro.popup_en: A special technique: allow the black pawn to promote, then capture the new queen with the rook. Place the rook on the back rank in advance and wait for the right moment.
intro.popup:
💡 特殊技巧：主动让黑兵升后，再用车立刻吃掉！
车提前占据升变格，等待时机。

outro.popup_en: This is the promotion-bait technique. The rook controls the back rank so it can capture the pawn as soon as it promotes; the white king then takes over the resulting ending.
outro.popup:
✅ 这是让升变技巧。
车提前占后排，兵一升就被吃，白王随后主导残局。

moves.popup_en: Check! Drive the black king away and give the white king time to join the fight.
moves.popup: 将军！赶走黑王，为白王进场争取时间。

moves.popup_en: The white king joins the battle.
The rook takes the back rank and waits for the black pawn to promote.
moves.popup: 车占后排，等待黑兵升变！

moves.popup_en: The black pawn promotes and is immediately captured by the rook.
